g.text: Monitoring, not diagnosis. Battery power only while a person touches the electrodes; never test on anyone with a pacemaker or ICD.

g.desc: Monitoring, not diagnosis. Battery power only while a person touches the electrodes; never test on anyone with a pacemaker or ICD.

g.text: Z = R5 x V(body) / V(R5): the gain cancels. Paths (S1 S0): 00 legs, 01 arms, 10 right side, 11 left side. Trunk = (Z3 + Z4 - Z1 - Z2) / 2.

g.desc: Z = R5 x V(body) / V(R5): the gain cancels. Paths (S1 S0): 00 legs, 01 arms, 10 right side, 11 left side. Trunk = (Z3 + Z4 - Z1 - Z2) / 2.

g.text: R8/R9 = 10 Mohm (LTspice Monte Carlo: 1 Mohm gave up to 12 % error). Firmware reads the 5 kHz Goertzel amplitude, never peak-to-peak (mains hum).

g.desc: R8/R9 = 10 Mohm (LTspice Monte Carlo: 1 Mohm gave up to 12 % error). Firmware reads the 5 kHz Goertzel amplitude, never peak-to-peak (mains hum).
